requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that the comparison schema mapping correctly transforms backend EVAL-COMPARE responses into the frontend contract defined in EVAL-COMPARE-UX-S1.
The system must execute unit tests verifying that normalization logic produces consistent relative scores across at least two providers with differing raw values.
The system must execute unit tests confirming that ranking logic correctly orders providers based on normalized scores.
The system must execute UI tests verifying that the comparison component renders multiple providers side-by-side with all required fields (identity, score, measures).
The system must execute UI tests confirming that visual indicators for strengths and weaknesses appear correctly based on computed deltas.
The system must execute integration tests verifying that API responses are correctly consumed and rendered without runtime errors.
The system must execute tests validating correct behavior when one or more providers have missing measure data, ensuring the UI renders placeholders or omissions without crashing.
The system must execute tests validating comparison behavior when providers have unequal sets of measures, ensuring alignment logic does not mis-map measures.
The system must execute tests confirming that the component supports rendering three or more providers simultaneously without layout or logic failure.
The system must execute UI tests verifying correct loading state rendering while awaiting API response.
The system must execute UI tests verifying correct error state rendering when the comparison API returns an error.
The system must execute tests ensuring that no uncaught exceptions occur during rendering when provided with null or empty comparison datasets.
The system must execute snapshot or DOM-based tests confirming consistent rendering output for a fixed comparison input.
The system must execute tests validating that state updates (e.g., changing selected providers) trigger correct re-render and recomputation of comparison results.
